     Can you bleed someone,play major boon and take your own bleed?

Messages.Author: Trevor Barrie
Messages.Body:
Tom Wylie writes:

>... Major Boon is an out-of-turn master card, so can't be used during
>your turn.  The only way I can think of to arrange to bleed someone
>when it's not your turn is with Malkavian Madness Network.  So this
>tactic is theoretically valid, but is useless for most practical purposes.

Eh? Is this in the rulebook somewhere? It's not mentioned on page 14, where
the different types of master cards are described. I had always assumed that
"out-of-turn" just meant that they weren't used on your master phase, not that
they couldn't be used on your own turn at all...

>"out-of-turn" just meant that they weren't used on your master phase, not that

not your turn.  This is clarified in the corrected rules.
